requirements_summary: Must guarantee minimum sustained throughput (tokens/sec) for peak 1-hour windows and defined concurrency caps; burst allowed for up to 5 minutes at 2x sustained rate; automated fallback to smaller model variant if reserved capacity exhausted; hard SLO: 95% of requests < 300ms per-token latency under declared concurrency; ability to reserve N GPUs per region with predictable provisioning time; KMS integration + audit logs for all inference requests.
throughput_negotiation_points: Min sustained throughput target requested: 120k tokens/sec across 3 regions (na-primary, eu-failover)
Concurrency cap preferred: 600 concurrent connections (chat sessions) with per-session token-per-sec shaping
Burst policy: allow bursts up to 2x sustained for 5 minutes, 1x sustained for up to 1 hour; any burst beyond triggers automatic circuit-breaker + billing at burst rate
Reserved GPU planning: Avalon wants a committed pool of 40 A100-equivalent GPUs with headroom for autoscale up to +20% for short windows
SLA language ask: uptime + latency credits tied to tokens/sec shortfall; clearly defined measurement windows and on-call escalation path
Fallback behavior: degraded quality model variant auto-route + informative error codes (so app can surface graceful message)
Performance POC: 48h replay of real traffic (anonymized) and Redwood to deliver verified tokens/sec and p95/p99 latency reports
